page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with 32 vCPUs, operating at one thread per core. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPUs, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core tests, such as stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core, register in the weak category. Conversely, multi-core performance is average, as demonstrated by the stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 23557.71 and Geekbench multi-core score of 8426.0. Memory bandwidth tests show average read speeds of 74.54 GB/sec and write speeds of 34.35 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, though Passmark memory scores fall into the weak tier.

This hardware profile is positioned for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage the 32 dedicated physical cores, such as software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, and static web serving. The lack of local storage and GPUs restricts its use for heavy database operations or hardware-accelerated machine learning. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a high density of dedicated physical cores relative to memory, making it suitable for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk I/O.
